# Profile

I am a Master of Science in Biostatistics student at Columbia University
with a background in public administration and experience in hospital
reporting, survey research, and operational data analysis. I have used
SQL and Excel to extract, clean, validate, and summarize administrative
data for hospital reports. My undergraduate projects involved questionnaire
design, descriptive analysis, and qualitative interviews on student
well-being and social behavior. I am developing my R and Python skills
through graduate coursework and seeking research assistant opportunities
in biomedical data management, statistical analysis, and research reporting.
